The included exact-arithmetic checker reruns all 3002 minors and all 243 candidates; standard John/Löwner theorem hypotheses are established.

value.rationale: R10 is the unique sporadic 10-element regular-matroid building block in Seymour decomposition; its generalized symmetric-edge polytope is a natural previously defined lattice polytope. A fully explicit maximal inscribed and minimal enclosing ellipsoid with every vertex and facet contacting, equality at sharp sqrt(5) symmetric John bound, and golden-ratio anisotropy provides a motivated structural classification rather than a trivial finite check.
